name: Kemo Kare! ~Oretachi no BL Byoutou~
source:
I, a handsome surgeon (name can be changed) contracted a new kind of disease... "Beast Disease". 

Symptom 1: Animal ears and tail grow and turn him into a beast
Symptom 2: When he's in heat, he's not satisfied until you ×× him!!

He was assigned to Tsukishiro Medical College, where he's trying to research this new disease...but he can't stop going into heat in front of the handsome doctors!

[Info from [url=http://www.fwinc.co.jp/goods/66699/]Frontier Works website[/url]]
translation:
身为英俊外科医生的我（姓名可更改），感染了一种新型疾病……“兽化病”。

第一种症状是长出兽耳与尾巴，逐渐化为野兽。
第二种症状是，一旦发情，就非得被××才能满足！！

他被调派到月城医科大学，试图研究这种新疾病……可面对那些英俊的医生，却根本无法抑制发情！
